Agalya .K.S vs Suresh on 11 June, 2024
Kabc030026092019
Presented on : 11-01-2019  Registered on : 11-01-2019

IN THE COURT OF THE I ADDL.CMM: BENGALURU  Dated this the 11th of June 2024  Present: Shri Prakash.C.D, B.A., LL.B  I Addl. C.M.M BENGALURU.
 JUDGMENT U/s.355 Cr.P.C.,
Case No. C.C.No.837/2019 Date of Offence 11/06/2018

Name of complainant State by High grounds  Police Station,
 Bengaluru.
(By Learned  Sr. APP)

V/ s. 
Name of accused Suresh, R/at.No.67, 2nd floor, 5th  main, Vasanthnagar, Bengaluru  (By Chandrakanth Maratha,
Advocates)
Offences complained off U/s.498A, 504 of IPC.
Plea of accused Pleaded not guilty Final Order Accused is acquitted
2 C.C.No.837/2019 Date of Order 11-06-2024  JUDGMENT

The charge sheet is submitted by the PSI of High grounds P.S, against the accused for the offences punishable under section 498A, 504 of I.P.C.
Agalya .K.S vs Suresh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76314687/
1 2.

The prosecution case in brief is as under ; That the accused married to CW-1 about 12 years back and while the CW1 was residing along with accused at house No.67, 5th main, Vasanthnagar, the accused used to pick up quarrel with CW-1 while leading matrimonial life with her for silly reasons and physically and mentally harassed her and on 11/6/18 the accused gone to the place where CW 1 was working, picked up quarrel with her and abused her in filthy language and also assaulted her with hands.

Thus the accused has committed the offences punishable under section 498A, 504 of I.P.C.
3.
The complainant has given complaint to the High grounds police station and accordingly the police have registered the case in crime No.77/2018.
The concerned police after completing the investigation have filed charge sheet against the accused.
4. On the receipt of charge sheet the cognizance was taken.
The prosecution papers are given to the accused.
The charge was framed and read over to the accused .
The accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried, accordingly the plea of the accused was recorded.

5. The prosecution in support of their case have got examined the complainant/victim as Pw.1 and got marked the document at Ex.P.1 & P2.
6.
The statement of accused U/s 313 of Cr.P.C is dispensed with as there was no incriminating evidence against the accused.
The accused has not chosen to adduce defence evidence.
7. Heard arguments on both side.

8. The points that arise for consideration is as under :
1. That the accused married to CW-1 about 12 years back and while the CW1 was residing along with accused at house No.67, 5th main, Vasanthnagar, the accused used to pick up quarrel with CW-1 while leading matrimonial life with her for silly reasons and physically and mentally harassed her and on 11/6/18 the accused gone to the place where CW1 was working, picked up quarrel with her and abused her in filthy language and also assaulted her with hands.
Thus the accused has committed the offences punishable under section 498A, 504 of I.P.C and within my cognizance ?
2. What order ?

9. My answers to the above points are as under ;
 Point No.1 : In the Negative.

Point No.2 : As per final order for the  following ;
 REASONS Agalya .K.S vs Suresh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76314687/

2 10. Point No.1 :- The allegation of the prosecution against the accused is that the accused married to CW-1 about 12 years back and while the CW1 was residing along with accused at house No.67, 5 th main, Vasanthnagar, the accused used to pick up quarrel with CW-1 while leading matrimonial life with her for silly reasons and physically and mentally harassed her
and on 11/6/18 the accused gone to the place where CW 1 was working, picked up quarrel with her and abused her in filthy language and also assaulted her with hands.

Thus the accused has committed the offences punishable under section 498A, 504 of I.P.C.
11.
In order to prove the allegations made against the accused, prosecution has got examined the complainant/victim as Pw.1 and got marked the complaint and spot panchanama at Ex.P.1 & 2 respectively.

12. On careful perusal of prosecution papers it shows that the specific allegation made against the accused that the accused has ill-treated the CW 1 mentally and physically and also abused her.
13.

In view of the allegation made against the accused, at the first it is proper to look in to the evidence of Cw.1 who is the complainant/victim, who is examined as PW-1.
14.

Further PW-1 who is the complainant and the victim of the alleged offence has deposed as under :
" 
      
 

 


    
 
 
 
 
 
  
 , 
  

   




  

 

 
     


 
 
 
  
 .
15. PW-1 being the complainant/victim has completely turned hostile and not supported the prosecution case and deposed that there was no any offence made by the accused.
16. Though the learned A.P.P treating the PW 1 as hostile and cross examined the Pw.1 but nothing is uttered by the Pw.1 in order to support the prosecution case.

It shows that the accused and the complainant/victim have compromised the matter out of the Court and as such she is not supporting the prosecution case.
17.

In the present case on hand the important material witness and victim of the offences herself has turned hostile and has not supported the case of prosecution and accordingly prosecution has utterly failed to prove the case.

The prayer of learned Sr.APP to issue summons to other witnesses is Rejected as no purpose will be served by issuing summons to other witnesses, as the complainant herself has turned hostile to the case of the prosecution.

Hence, it cannot be held that the accused has committed the offences punishable under section 498A, 504 of I.P.C. Accordingly I answered this point in the Negative.
18. Point No.2

: - In view the findings given in point No.1, I proceed to pass the following ;
ORDER

Acting under section 248(1) of Cr.P.C accused is hereby Acquitted for the offence punishable under section 498A, 504 of I.P.C.
Agalya .K.S vs Suresh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76314687/
3
The bail bond of surety bond of accused stands canceled after appeal period is over.
(This judgment is dictated to stenographer directly on computer, typed by her, corrected and then pronounced by me in the open court on this the 11 th day June 2024) (PRAKASH.C.D) I Addl.

Ex. P.1(a) : Signature of PW-1.
Ex. P2 : Spot panchanama.
Ex. P2(a) : Signature of Pw.1.

WITNESSES EXAMINED BY THE ACCUSED :-
-Nil- DOCUMENTS GOT MARKED BY THE ACCUSED :-
-Nil- MATERIAL OBJECTS IDENTIFIED :-
-Nil- I Addl.
Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru Agalya
